candidate.definition_en: A man who is in charge of a school; a principal.
candidate.explanation_ar: مدير المدرسة 'الناظر'. الشخص المسؤول عن المدرسة كلها.

senses.definition_en: A man who is in charge of a school; a principal.
senses.explanation_ar: مدير المدرسة أو الناظر المسؤول عن إدارتها.
examples: The headmaster spoke to the students.
The headmaster retired after 30 years of service.
The role of the headmaster has evolved into that of a CEO.
